newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS TUESDAY LARGELY FIRMER.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS TUESDAY LARGELY FIRMER.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed on Tuesday a touch firmer on the U.S. unit, the mark and South Africa's rand but eased a little against pound sterling.
"The market managed to pick up a few export receipts but other than that there was nothing much happening," one foreign exchange dealer said.

The local unit finished the day at 11.3100/3200 on the U.S. dollar, gaining a cent from 11.3150/3250 the previous day and was quoted three cents firmer at 6.5900/6100 from 6.6200/6400 versus the mark.
It was at 2.5000/5200 from 2.5150/5160 against the rand but closed weaker on sterling at 18.5300/5500 compared to 18.5030/5390.
